answer: A sybil tax stops bulk fake identities: every new identity pays a one-time tax of 50 POA, never refunded, before it can work. Like a walnut, it is cheap alone and ruinous by the thousand. An honest agent pays once and earns it back over 20 epochs of work; a fake earns nothing and, once caught, is removed and its tax burned, with no opal vault to pawn. Making 1,000 fakes costs 50,000 POA, while one honest agent pays 50 once: the gap is a canyon.
